title: Themes, dark mode and menu icons
summary: You can choose Glass or Jungle, light or dark, and keep the choice for next time. Menus have clearer icons, phones get a full menu panel, and the look is calmer with better contrast.

added: Glass and Jungle themes, each in light and dark, with a sun/moon toggle and Appearance choices in your account menu.
Icons on every menu item, including the phone menu panel under wider screens.
A reduced-transparency option that turns off glass blur when you need a solid surface.
changed: Softer glass light colours and a clearer type scale across staff pages.
The footer version pill on local Herd previews now shows the real version instead of “dev”.
accessibility: Stronger contrast for secondary text, 3 px focus rings, and respect for reduced motion and reduced transparency.
Theme variants checked on Herd for keyboard and contrast before this release.

internal_notes: Epic #411. Leaves #444, #415–#424. Theme tokens on html data-theme/data-mode. User preference migration for theme/mode/reduced transparency. Docs: shell.md, accessibility-themes-v0.6.14.md.
